name: @gltf-studio/audio-canvas
description: Audio-graph canvas for KHR_audio_graph (specs/ux-audio-graph.md UX-6xx): a second canvas instance on graph-canvas's shared React Flow + ELK engine (GraphView/NodeDetails), a KHR_audio_graph -> MappedGraph projection, an AudioGraphEdit-backed editing layer (palette, connect/disconnect/move/param-edit/delete), the AudioGraphHost lint banner + per-node badges, and an audition control.
